4a_duality_identity.finding: the identity holds against the PATH (interfering system) purity always; it holds against the MARKER purity only when the joint state is pure, where the Schmidt decomposition forces the two purities equal

4b_englert_inequality.note: excess is at the 1e-8 level, set by eigenvalue clipping inside the fidelity operator -- numerical, not a violation

4c_streltsov.finding: entanglement generated equals coherence consumed to machine precision whenever the ancilla map is injective (the generalised CNOT); the gap under other incoherent operations is exactly the branches the ancilla fails to resolve -- coupling suboptimality, not missing physics
